messages:
alex: Taking the lead on the upcoming pen-test next Wed. Need to lock scope, RBAC windows, and observability proof points. Can folks confirm who will own evidence packaging, readroom creds, and KMS access window?

maria: I can own evidence packaging + presigned logs. Quick q: retention window — 90d ok? Also what KMS policy are we doing for assessors: ephemeral roles or a key-proxy pattern?

chong: Ephemeral roles + KMS proxy. Don’t give raw Decrypt perms. Flow = presigned S3 upload -> decrypt via short-lived proxy role if needed.

sre-lead: +1. Also we need explicit audit events shipped to the SIEM: assume-role, sts:AssumeRole, kms:Decrypt, s3:PutObject, and CloudTrail management events. Who will validate the pipeline?

alex: I'll validate the pipeline. Pasting the minimal log checklist I want in readroom (please review). @maria can you add to the readroom docs?

maria: sure, adding now. paste: ```
- Enable CloudTrail management + data events for S3 & KMS
- Retain CloudTrail logs for 90 days (archive 1y if requested)
- Export CloudTrail data events to SIEM via Kinesis Firehose (encrypted)
- Enable S3 object-level logging + versioning on evidence bucket
- Create presigned upload URLs scoped to a GUID folder (no wildcard paths)
- Provide ephemeral role ARNs for assessor access and document exact time window
- Add explicit SIEM parsers for kms:Decrypt and sts:AssumeRole
```

security-bot: Reminder: create ticket PT-2025-42 and assign to alex,maria,chong (auto-reminder in 24h).

alex: Created PT ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/PT-2025-42. I added the checklist and initial owners. We also need a rollback corridor: minimal steps to revert any noisy test activity quickly.

chong: Rollback plan draft: 
1) Revoke ephemeral role session permissions (IAM revoke)
2) Invalidate presigned URLs by rotating the upload token/service secret or moving the active folder prefix
3) If a KMS envelope key is compromised, rotate the data key and revoke proxy policy (note: full CMK rotation is heavy)
Aim for <5m mean time-to-revoke. Will prep an IAM runbook.

maria: For evidence integrity: do we let assessors upload directly or should we require signed manifests they submit alongside uploads? I prefer signed manifests + presigned uploads to minimize tampering.

sre-lead: Signed manifests + presigned uploads looks good from audited chain-of-custody POV. We'll also snapshot manifest + object hashes to an immutable bucket and record in the SIEM. Also add an alert exception for assessor role to avoid noisy egress alarms.

alex: Great. Operating questions: 
- Can we schedule a dry-run on Monday (full presigned upload + manifest check + SIEM hit)?
- Who is primary on-call for escalations during the live test?

maria: I can do the dry-run Mon 14:00 PT. Will post the readroom link and sample manifest template.

chong: I'll be on-call for KMS/roles and can be reached at +1-555-0102.

sre-lead: I'll own SIEM validation and can standby on the bridge. Create a slack huddle if things escalate.

alex: Awesome — final asks before I lock scope: anyone object to the KMS-proxy + ephemeral roles approach? Any compliance flags?

maria: No objections from my side. Will include retention and manifest template in the readroom.

chong: No objections. Will draft the revoke playbook and attach to the ticket.

sre-lead: Compliance: verify legal ok with the readroom upload policy (signed manifest + presigned upload ok). I'll loop in legal via the ticket.

alex: Perfect. Next steps: 
- maria: add checklist + manifest template to readroom (by EOD)
- chong: draft revoke runbook + IAM playbook (by EOD)
- sre-lead: confirm SIEM parsers and exceptions and link to ticket (by EOD)
- alex: schedule dry-run Monday 14:00 PT and send calendar invite

security-bot: PT ticket PT-2025-42 created and watchers set: alex,maria,chong,sre-lead. Reminder scheduled for dry-run 24h before.

maria: noted. linking readroom: https://readroom.internal/redwood/pt-2025-42-evidence (draft)

alex: Thanks all — closing scope lock after dry-run passes. If anyone sees an edge-case (backup restores, cross-account access), flag it in the ticket. :thumbsup:
